title: Aro Aro no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + full arrow control as the peak (no stages and no awakening known)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Arrow-Arrow Fruit: produces arrow-shaped strips from the body and moves them telekinetically
Adds speed and mass to her strikes with the arrows
A knife cannot cut through the arrows (Robin notes it)
Arrows used to pierce, bind and redirect in fights
User: Manmayer Gunko, one of the God's Knights (Holy Knights); fought the Straw Hats in Elbaph

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in pink stands in (no face or limbs).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a knight in silver armour with a red-plumed helmet.

**Manmayer Gunko (matched to your reference):** black cap with gold goggles, short blue hair, white face mask, high black collar, pink cape with a red lining, short black double-breasted coat with gold buttons, bandaged legs, tall purple platform boots.
**Arrows:** flat white arrow strips with a light-blue underside, like in your reference.
plan.sets: archery range, rose rays, signpost crossroads, windy hill, compass-rose hall, stone courtyard, running track, butcher shop with knives, rail yard at sunset, dark cathedral, white-and-gold palace above the clouds, giant forest of Elbaph with a huge sword, hedge maze.
